The requested definitions and clause content are as follows:

**Definitions [L34-L96]**
*   **"Current":** [L38-L74] (detailed timelines for Conditional and Final CMMC Status and affirmation of continuous compliance).
*   **"Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) status":** [L76-L90] (the result of meeting/exceeding minimum required scores, including statuses like Final Level 1, Conditional/Final Level 2, and Conditional/Final Level 3).
*   **"Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification unique identifier (CMMC UID)":** [L92] 10 alpha-numeric characters assigned to each assessment and reflected in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS).

**Paragraph (b): Framework [L98]**
"The Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) is a framework for assessing a contractor’s compliance with applicable information security protections (see 32 CFR part 170)."

**Paragraph (c): Duplication [L100]**
"The CMMC assessments will not duplicate efforts from any other comparable DoD assessment, except for rare circumstances when a reassessment may be necessary, for example, when there are indications of issues with cybersecurity and/or compliance with CMMC requirements."

**Paragraph (d): Requirements [L102-L114]**
The Contractor shall:
*   (1)(i) Maintain a current CMMC status at the required CMMC level for systems processing/storing/transmitting FCI or CUI [L104].
*   (1)(ii) Consult 32 CFR 170.23 for flowdown requirements [L106].
*   (2) Only process/store/transmit FCI or CUI on systems with the required CMMC status [L108].
*   (3) Complete/maintain an annual affirmation of continuous compliance in the SPRS for each applicable CMMC UID [L110].
*   (4) Ensure subcontractors complete/maintain an annual affirmation of continuous compliance for relevant systems [L112].
*   (5) Close out any valid plan of action and milestones (32 CFR 170.21) if the CMMC Status is Conditional [L114].
